q: The Indian Navy and Coast Guard are planning a ₹15,000-crore deal for 76 Utility Helicopters to replace which ageing fleet?
why: The ₹15,000-crore procurement deal aims to replace the ageing Cheetah and Chetak helicopters.

q: Which NASA spacecraft reached a distance of one light-day from Earth on November 18?
why: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft reached a distance of 1 light-day from Earth on November 18.

q: The 300-year-old historic Lavi Fair, which celebrates traditional Himalayan trade, is held in which place?
why: Rampur's Lavi Fair celebrates 300 years of traditional Himalayan trade.

q: Which three banks maintained their Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB) status according to the Reserve Bank of India?
options: SBI, Punjab National Bank, Axis Bank
Bank of Baroda, HDFC Bank, Canara Bank
ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank
why: The RBI maintained the D-SIB status for SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank.

q: Which sports organisation refused to review the ban on using saliva to polish balls?
options: Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)
why: The ICC stated it has no plans to review the saliva ban despite requests from players.
